decision: Determine why fixed-checkpoint planning success falls with depth. On identical balanced future-action trees, compare the deployed terminal-only score against the checkpoint's one-step root ordering and an oracle endpoint ordering, under both learned latent and exact symbolic transitions, while sweeping continuation count. If symbolic terminal scoring degrades while one-step and oracle endpoint ordering remain sound, the primary cause is score-composition or calibration mismatch. If only latent scoring degrades, rollout drift is primary. If degradation grows with continuation count and selection optimism, extreme-value selection contributes. After these causal audits, complete missing full-GAR seed-level local geometry audits for cross-seed planning correlations.

jobs.purpose: Causal fixed-checkpoint diagnosis of planning-depth degradation, followed by the missing seed-level local GAR geometry measurements. Depth above one is explicitly candidate-privileged and symbolic labels remain post-hoc diagnostics.
